clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, Sirra Von'Indi studies the records that hold Duskwood's history. The town's historian knows ancient languages and helps decipher mysterious documents and the region's past.

In Darkshire Town Hall, Sirra Von'Indi keeps the settlement's archives. While the town guard faces threats in the woods, he studies old texts and preserves the history of Grand Hamlet from before shadow fell across the region.
